Error when extracting with invalid MIME type format

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig
from xberg import XbergError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"bytes\":\"text/plain.txt\",\"config\":{},\"filename\":\"plain.txt\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"not-a-mime\"}")
        config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{}")
        result = await extract(input, config)
    except XbergError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
